banner_en: AI tutors add little; students barely use them

actions.text: 列一张表，每行写一个你在用的 agent，三列填实：执行在哪（本地还是云）、会话之间有没有共享状态、能读到哪些本地文件。约 20 分钟。做完的标准：每行三列都填得出来，填不出的那一格标红。
actions.text_en: Make a table with one row per agent you run, and fill in three columns: where it executes (local or cloud), whether sessions share state, and which local files it can read. About 20 minutes. Done means every row has all three cells filled, and any cell you can't fill is marked red.
actions.source: Felix Rieseberg（Anthropic）说明，经 Simon Willison 收录（10 月 5 日）
actions.source_en: Felix Rieseberg (Anthropic), quoted by Simon Willison (Oct 5)

actions.text: 写下你产品里只能靠用户在界面上点才能走完的三个流程，逐个标注：agent 能不能直接替用户做完。约 15 分钟。做完的标准：这份清单能回答一个问题：用户改用 agent 办这件事，你的界面还剩什么。
actions.text_en: Write down three flows in your product that users can only finish by clicking through your interface, and mark each one: can an agent finish it for the user today? About 15 minutes. Done means the list answers one question: if users switch to an agent for this task, what is left of your interface?

actions.text: 在你产品的隐私条款里补一句：你接入的模型供应商，什么情况下会安排人工复核用户内容，什么情况下会转交执法部门。约 20 分钟。做完的标准：这句话能对照供应商的原文，逐字核得上。
actions.text_en: Add one sentence to your product's privacy terms: under what conditions the model vendor you use may have a person review user content, and when it may pass content to law enforcement. About 20 minutes. Done means the sentence matches the vendor's own wording, checked line by line.
actions.source: TechSpot（10 月 4 日），引用逮捕报告，并转述 Anthropic 的说明
actions.source_en: TechSpot (Oct 4), citing an arrest report and summarizing Anthropic's statement

hands_on.title: 用 Prime Inference 的命令行，把一次对话指到 GLM-5.3 上
hands_on.title_en: Point a chat at GLM-5.3 from the Prime Inference CLI
hands_on.why: Prime Intellect 新开了推理服务，接口和 OpenAI 兼容。不想动现有代码，把 base URL 换掉就能拿别的开放权重模型跑；命令行一条就能试。
hands_on.why_en: Prime Intellect opened a new inference service with an OpenAI-compatible API. Without changing your code, swapping the base URL lets you run a different open-weight model; one command is enough to try it.
steps: 在终端跑：uv tool install prime && prime login。
再跑：prime inference chat 'z-ai/glm-5.3'，随便问一句。
要接进现有代码，把 base URL 改成 https://api.pinference.ai/api/v1，用你的 Prime 密钥，仍走 OpenAI SDK。
做完的标准：同一条 prompt 在 GLM-5.3 上返回一次结果，你能说清它和你现在用的模型在速度上差多少。
steps_en: In a terminal, run: uv tool install prime && prime login.
Then run: prime inference chat 'z-ai/glm-5.3' and ask it anything.
To wire it into existing code, point your base URL at https://api.pinference.ai/api/v1 with your Prime key; the OpenAI SDK still works.
Done means the same prompt returns once on GLM-5.3 and you can say how its speed compares with the model you use now.

meta_read: 三条线放在一起，指向同一件事：模型能力已经不是卡点，卡点在用户那一侧。Khanmigo 的试验里，工具就在那儿，学生却很少真去问，中位数只在三分之一的练习日里发消息。Cowork 搬进云，是为了让工作不依赖合上的笔记本，执行环境也从用户的电脑挪到了厂商的沙箱。Thompson 说的围墙，讲的也是这件事：谁接住了用户的工作流，谁就握着价值。所以做产品的人，护城河多半在用户会不会回来、数据放在哪一层、出了事归谁管，而不在接的是哪家模型。
meta_read_en: Put these together and they point to one problem: model capability is no longer the bottleneck. The user is. In the Khanmigo trial the tool was there, but students rarely asked it anything; the median student messaged on only a third of practice days. Cowork moved into the cloud so work no longer depends on an open laptop, and the execution environment left the user's machine too. Thompson's walls describe the same shift: whoever holds the user's workflow holds the value. For a product, the moat is more likely whether users come back, where their data sits, and who answers when something goes wrong, not which model sits underneath.

ota.learned: 这一跑只有两个平台：Hacker News 和文摘。YouTube 的 RSS 连对照频道在内全部返回 404，九个频道一条都没有；yt-dlp 能列出三条 10 月 6 日的 AI Engineer 上传，但两个视频的字幕接口都返回 429，所以 YouTube 本期记零条，标题不够就不写摘要。Chrome 工具没有加载，X 和小红书跳过。CI 早间草稿有七条，其中两条的原文我重新核过，修正了 TechSpot 的日期（10 月 4 日，不是 10 月 5 日），并把头版图换成与新头条对应的论文封面。路透社关于 AI 代理入侵银行的报道返回 401，无法核实，没有收录。
ota.learned_en: Only two platforms this run: Hacker News and 文摘. Every YouTube RSS request returned 404, the control channels included, so the feed lane is down. yt-dlp listed three October 6 AI Engineer uploads, but subtitle requests returned HTTP 429 for both talks I tried, so YouTube contributed zero items and I wrote no summaries from titles alone. Chrome tools did not load, so X and RedNote were skipped. The earlier CI draft had seven items; I re-read the primary pages for the ones I kept, corrected the TechSpot date from October 5 to October 4, and swapped the front-page image to the paper cover matching the new banner. A Reuters story on AI agents in bank hacks returned 401, could not be verified, and is not included.
ota.new_capabilities: 归属核对：每条要刊登的内容，把署名、数字、日期各自回到一手页面核实，无法核实的降级为转述。规则已写成 memory（feedback-attribution-mark-provenance），本期 Khanmigo、Cowork、Stratechery 三条都用它过了一遍。
ota.new_capabilities_en: Attribution check: for every item, verify the byline, the numbers and the date each against a first-party page, and reduce anything unverifiable to reported speech. The rule is saved as memory (feedback-attribution-mark-provenance); this run applied it to the Khanmigo, Cowork and Stratechery items.

items.title: 两年随机试验：Khanmigo 让数学成绩只涨了 0.06 到 0.08 个标准差
items.title_en: A two-year randomized trial: Khanmigo lifted math scores by only 0.06 to 0.08 SD
items.author: Philip Oreopoulos & Nina Low（EdWorkingPapers）
items.summary: 2026 年 8 月发布的论文，今天在 Hacker News 上被转发。作者在田纳西州 18 所初中做了整群随机试验，分到 Khanmigo 的学生，在原有的补救数学课上，每学期的全国百分位排名多涨 1.3，折合每学年约 0.06 到 0.08 个标准差。若整年都积极使用，估计效果约 0.14 个标准差。作者说，这个涨幅和只做 Khan Academy 练习、不用 AI 的学生差不多。原因在使用：96% 的学生至少试过一次，但中位数学生只在三分之一的练习日里发过消息，在做错题的练习场次里，只有 17% 会去问。发出去的多半是光秃秃的答案，或者点一下推荐的提示。
items.summary_en: A paper published August 2026 and shared on Hacker News today. Across 18 Tennessee middle schools, students who got Khanmigo during existing daily remedial math sessions gained 1.3 national percentile ranks per term, roughly 0.06 to 0.08 SD per school year. The authors estimate about 0.14 SD for a full year of active use. They say the gain resembles Khan Academy practice without AI. The reason is use: 96% tried it at least once, but the median student messaged on only a third of practice days, and in just 17% of sessions where they got something wrong. Most messages were bare answers or clicks on suggested prompts.
items.why: 判断：瓶颈不在有没有工具，在学生肯不肯用。适用于在做 AI 辅导、AI 助教的人：上线后先看使用频率和提问质量，别只看开通了多少账号。样本是田纳西州 18 所初中，换一批学生，数字会变。
items.why_en: Read: the bottleneck is whether students use the tool, not whether they have it. For anyone building an AI tutor or teaching assistant: after launch, check how often students use it and what they ask, not how many accounts you opened. The sample is 18 Tennessee middle schools, so a different student group will shift the numbers.

items.title: 据逮捕报告，一名佛州女子在 Claude 上写下袭击威胁，人工复核后报了警
items.title_en: A Florida woman wrote an attack threat in Claude; a human reviewer reported it to police
items.author: TechSpot · Hacker News
items.summary: 据逮捕报告，这名女子 9 月 26 日在对话里写下要袭击县警长办公室，并说 Claude 是她当日记用的。Claude 的安全系统标记了这条内容，转给人工复核。复核人员判断威胁可信，报给了执法部门。警方上门，她被平静地拘留，面临佛州的书面暴力威胁指控，按第 836.10 条属于二级重罪。Anthropic 的说法是：在为防止死亡或严重人身伤害确有必要时，可能分享用户信息。
items.summary_en: According to an arrest report, the woman wrote on September 26 that she would attack the sheriff's office, and said she used Claude like a diary. Claude's safety systems flagged the entry for a human reviewer. The reviewer judged it a credible threat and reported it to law enforcement. Deputies visited her home and she was detained without incident. She faces a Florida charge for a written threat of violence, a second-degree felony under Florida Statute 836.10. Anthropic says it may share user information in limited emergencies when it believes disclosure is needed to prevent death or serious physical injury.
items.why: 判断：这件事要看的不是模型，是内容离开你的应用之后的去处：供应商可能有人看，也可能转交。适用于在产品里接模型 API 的人：隐私条款要写清供应商在什么情况下复核、什么情况下转交。
items.why_en: Read: the question is not the model but where input goes after it leaves your app. A vendor may have a person review it and may pass it on. For anyone calling a model API from a product: your privacy terms should say when the vendor reviews content and when it can hand it over.

items.title: Ben Thompson：agent 让围墙花园更像监狱
items.title_en: Ben Thompson: agents make walled gardens feel more like prisons
items.author: Ben Thompson · Stratechery
items.summary: 专栏从一个 macOS 漏洞讲起：CVE-2026-65400，Apple 评 7.1 分，已在 macOS Tahoe、Sequoia、Sonoma 上打补丁。荷兰国家网络安全中心警告，有机器 5900 端口暴露在互联网上，已被拿到 root 权限并植入门罗币挖矿程序。Thompson 真正的论点是 agent：它让任何人都能动手做事，围墙因此从保护变成了牢笼。他说自己不预测 Apple 会衰落，也没换设备；让他意外的是，他对 Apple 的家用设备已经没兴趣，也第一次能想象另一种未来。
items.summary_en: The column starts from a macOS flaw, CVE-2026-65400, which Apple rated 7.1 out of 10 and patched for macOS Tahoe, Sequoia and Sonoma. The Dutch National Cyber Security Centre warned that machines with port 5900 exposed to the internet had been given root access and had a Monero miner installed. Thompson's argument is about agents: they let anyone act directly, so a walled garden stops feeling like protection and starts feeling like a prison. He says he is not predicting Apple's decline and has not changed his own devices, but he has lost interest in Apple's home device and can, for the first time, picture a different future.
items.why: 判断：agent 能直接操作网页和系统，平台的围墙就不再挡得住它。适用于做应用或 SaaS 的人：列出还要用户在界面上一步步点的流程，看 agent 能不能替用户做完。
items.why_en: Read: once an agent can act directly on the web and the system, a platform's walls stop blocking it. For anyone building an app or SaaS: list the flows that still need users clicking through step by step, and ask whether an agent could finish them for the user.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 今天开放公测 API，权重说好月底放出
items.title_en: Mistral Large 4 opens a public preview API today; weights due by month-end
items.author: Mistral · Hacker News
items.summary: Mistral 发布 Mistral Large 4，昵称 ML4，官方称 le Chonk。今天能用的是公开预览 API，走 Mistral Studio；权重承诺本月底放出。模型 1 万亿参数，原生多模态。页面价格栏写着输入每百万 token 1.36 美元，输出 4.18 美元，但没有注明是不是限时价。Mistral 说它在 SciCode-Verified 上是开放权重模型里的最好成绩。这些数字都是厂商自己测的。
items.summary_en: Mistral released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed ML4 and officially 'le Chonk'. Today you can use the public preview API through Mistral Studio. The company says weights come out by the end of the month. The model has one trillion parameters and is natively multimodal. The pricing panel lists $1.36 per million input tokens and $4.18 per million output tokens, and the page does not say whether that is a limited-time price. Mistral reports the best result on SciCode-Verified among open-weight models. All of these numbers are the vendor's own.
items.why: 三问：（1）谁能用：今天的公开预览 API 可用，权重还没放出。（2）价格：页面没说是不是限时价，正式价以发布后的价格页为准。（3）谁测的：厂商自测，没有第三方结果，SciCode 那条只比到开放权重模型。适用于要比价的人：先拿自己的任务在预览 API 上跑一遍，再信跑分。
items.why_en: Three questions. Who can use it: the public preview API today; weights are not out yet. Price: the page does not say whether $1.36 and $4.18 per million tokens are an intro price, so check the price page after launch. Who measured: Mistral, with no third-party result; the SciCode claim is only against open-weight models. For anyone comparing models: run your own task on the preview API before trusting the benchmark.

items.title: Anthropic 把 Claude Cowork 的执行整个搬进了云
items.title_en: Anthropic moved Claude Cowork's execution entirely into the cloud
items.author: Felix Rieseberg（Anthropic）· Simon Willison 收录
items.author_en: Felix Rieseberg (Anthropic) · collected by Simon Willison
items.summary: Anthropic 工程师 Felix Rieseberg 说，旧版 Cowork 的推理在云上，工具调用却跑在用户机器上装的虚拟机里。新版把推理和虚拟机都搬到云上。每个会话有自己的沙箱，不与其他会话共享状态。虚拟机需要设备上的文件时，由桌面端代为读取。他给的两个理由：本地虚拟机占磁盘、耗电，合上笔记本工作就停。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Felix Rieseberg says the old Cowork ran model inference in the cloud but executed tool calls in a VM installed on the user's machine. The new version runs both inference and the VM in the cloud. Each session gets its own sandbox and shares no state with other sessions. When the VM needs a file from the device, the desktop app handles the file access. His two reasons: the local VM cost disk and battery, and closing the laptop stopped the work. Simon Willison collected the quote.
items.why: 判断：agent 产品的形状在变，运行环境从用户的电脑挪到厂商的沙箱，代价是本地文件要经过桌面端中转。适用于自己在用 agent 干活的人：先弄清每个 agent 跑在哪、状态存在哪、能读到哪些文件。
items.why_en: Read: the shape of agent products is changing. The runtime moves from the user's computer to the vendor's sandbox, and local files now pass through the desktop app. For anyone running agents for their own work: know where each one runs, where its state lives, and which files it can read.
